correctness.rationale: Proof completely characterizes independent zero sets, derives exact weight formula, proves a full row cannot be defended by one label 2, checks the total-positive condition for every proposed equality configuration, and counts two disjoint equality classes for r>=3. At r=2 positivity requires two survivors in any zero-containing side, yielding the corrected sharp bound, matched-pair exceptions, and all-weight partition. Direct brute-force adjacency checks for seven graph sizes and full crown coefficient comparisons through n=6 agree with proof; finite checks are not substituted for universality.
